name: Ciaora!

boost.name: Ciao Bella
effect: Advance up to 2 spaces.
HIT: Draw a card.
AFTER: Gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the Strike).
description: Raora的招牌招呼語「Ciaora!」（Ciao + Raora的合成詞）。這張牌代表她熱情開朗的義大利性格，極高速的輕擊後抽牌並搶佔先機，如同她總是以充滿活力的問候抓住觀眾的心。

name: God Eyes

boost.name: Insight
effect: Ignore Guard.
BEFORE: Look at your opponent's hand.
HIT: +2 Power if the opponent has any Boost cards in play.
description: Raora的核心能力「神之眼」（God Eyes）賦予她超凡的觀察力。這張牌讓她能預先窺視對手手牌並無視防禦，就像她能看穿一切偽裝與謊言，直達事物的本質，洞察對手的一切戰術。

name: Panthera's Prowl

boost.name: Cat's Agility
effect: Move up to 3 spaces.
HIT: Move 1 space.
HIT: If you are at range 1, gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the Strike).
description: 身為黑豹（Panthera）獸娘，Raora擁有貓科動物的敏捷身手。這張牌代表她在戰場上靈活移動的能力，如同黑豹悄無聲息地接近獵物，在極近距離發動攻擊後奪取先機。

name: Pizza Margherita

boost.name: Extra Cheese
effect: Gain 2 life at the start of your turn.
Gain 2 life.
AFTER: Add this card to your Gauge at the end of the Strike.
description: Raora對瑪格麗特披薩有著義大利人式的堅持——絕對不能加鳳梨！這張牌代表她在戰鬥中小憩享用美食來回復體力，並可回收至計量條，完美體現她慵懶悠閒又對美食充滿熱情的貓系生活態度。

name: Artistic Rendering

boost.name: Sketchbook
effect: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Put one into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your deck.
HIT: Your opponent discards a card at random.
description: 作為「神之眼的藝術家」，Raora能極度準確地繪製容貌拼圖。這張牌結合她的繪畫才能與情報收集能力：透過描繪對手的樣貌來干擾對方（隨機棄牌），同時整理自己的思緒（濾牌），展現藝術家的從容。

name: Detective's Instinct

boost.name: Case File
effect: Name a card. Your opponent must reveal their hand and discards all copies of it.
HIT: Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose a card and return it to their deck.
description: Raora作為偵探的情報收集能力——從社交技巧到社群媒體，再到各種「獨特的方法」，無所不包。此牌模擬她深入調查的過程：先鎖定目標（指定卡片名稱迫使對手棄掉），命中後再從對手手牌中移除關鍵證據。

name: God Eyes - Awakened

boost.name: Truth Seeker
effect: Strike.
If you win the Strike, look at the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck and rearrange them in any order.
Ignore Armor.
Ignore Guard.
HIT: Your opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a card and add it to your hand.
description: Raora解放「神之眼」的真正力量，雙眼發出紫色光芒。在這種狀態下她能看穿一切防禦，洞察對手的所有秘密，甚至奪取對方的關鍵卡片納為己用，展現神之眼持有者的絕對壓制力與情報支配。

name: La Dolce Vita

boost.name: Espresso Shot
effect: +3 Power.
Stun Immunity.
HIT: Gain 3 life.
HIT: You may move the opponent up to 2 spaces.
AFTER: Draw 2 cards.
description: 義大利文「甜蜜的生活」——代表Raora的義大利享樂主義哲學。這張牌不僅是攻擊，更是一場生活方式的展現：在戰鬥中享受咖啡、美食與藝術，透過回復生命、控場與抽牌來展現義大利式的從容與愜意，甜蜜而又致命。

name: Panthera's Hunt

boost.name: Ambush
effect: +2 Power.
If you are at range 1, +2 additional Power.
Stun Immunity.
HIT: Push the opponent 2 spaces.
HIT: If this Strike was initiated at range 1, your opponent discards their entire hand.
description: 黑豹（Panthera）的狩獵本能完全釋放。作為頂級捕食者，Raora在近距離發動最致命的終結一擊——先清空對手所有資源（手牌），再將獵物推開，完成一次完美的狩獵。代價高昂但威力無與倫比。

name: Masterpiece of Truth

boost.name: Final Brushstroke
effect: Search your deck for 2 cards and add them to your hand. Shuffle your deck afterwards.
HIT: Name 2 cards. Your opponent reveals their hand and discards all copies of those cards.
AFTER: Gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the Strike).
description: 結合Raora的藝術家與偵探身份的終極傑作。她運用神之眼繪製出對手的完整畫像，徹底看穿對方的戰術佈局。這幅「真相的傑作」不僅讓她補充大量資源，還能精準摧毀對手的關鍵卡片，取得完全的資訊與節奏主導權。
